description: Ephemeral typing-presence heartbeat for a conversation. Deterministic rkey per (caller, convoId): each isTyping=true call overwrites the same record rather than accumulating, and the AppView projection (listTyping) treats any record older than a few seconds as stale — so this is safe to call repeatedly while composing, and there is no separate cleanup job. isTyping=false deletes the record immediately so peers stop seeing the indicator right away, rather than waiting out the staleness window.
